core.headline: Detached house, indoor pool, 2.1 acres, Pilgrims Way, Wrotham
core.summary: Detached house with indoor swimming pool and triple garage set in 2.1 acres within the Kent Downs National Landscape and Metropolitan Green Belt. Guide Price £1,250,000. Freehold. Council Tax band G. EPC rating D
core.listing:
Hollybank is a detached four-bedroom house occupying 2.1 acres within the Kent Downs National Landscape and the Metropolitan Green Belt. The property stands on Pilgrims Way, Wrotham.

Built in 1987, the house offers three reception rooms. The accommodation includes an indoor swimming pool.

The property has a kitchen and family space.

There are four bedrooms and three bathrooms.

The grounds extend to 2.1 acres. A triple garage and driveway provide parking.

Wrotham is located in Tonbridge and Malling.

Guide Price £1,250,000. Freehold. Council Tax band G (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). EPC rating D. Construction: standard. Mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage. Heating: oil-fired central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: good outdoor coverage on major networks. Parking: driveway. The property is within the Kent Downs National Landscape and the Metropolitan Green Belt. Building safety, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield/mining: none known.
keyFeatures: 2.1-acre plot within the Kent Downs National Landscape
